en.askTitle: Swap in your own dates and budget and get a month-abroad plan with every fee and caveat kept
en.runTitle: Toronto-hours remote worker, one month in Mexico City: USD 2,800, 1–31 March 2027

fields.label: Budget currency and amount
fields.value: About USD 2,800 for the month, excluding flights

fields.label: Separate deposit cash
fields.placeholder: e.g. USD 1,500 set aside on top for a deposit

fields.label: Workspace needs
fields.placeholder: e.g. quiet desk, reliable Wi-Fi, open to 19:00

fields.label: Preferred areas
fields.value: Roma Norte, Condesa, Narvarte, Del Valle, Coyoacán

en.template: Plan a working month in Mexico City for {dates}, with {passport}, {employer}, {budget}, {deposit}, {workspace} and {areas}. Compare dated housing leads, full fees, daily work hours, coworking commitments and transport. Flag immigration, tax and insurance questions for professional confirmation. Plan only; do not contact hosts, create accounts, book or pay.

phases.title: Look up housing, coworking, transport, health and entry sources
phases.note: Official entry and health pages, plus coworking and rental sites

phases.title: Write the practical guide and the source log
phases.note: Neighbourhood trade-offs, housing and coworking prices, transport, budget table
phases.judgment: Housing is labelled as advertised rates, not confirmed March vacancies: only one listing (Narvarte, MXN 26,000 a month) explicitly covers 1 March–31 May 2027. A second colleague re-checked all ten against the original pages, and a USD 2,900 figure that could not be supported was withdrawn, because the page shows USD 2,600.

phases.title: Check the content, the budget arithmetic and the finished page
phases.judgment: The month budget is checked at MXN 50,400 / USD 2,800, and the guide says openly that the exchange rate behind it is an assumption.

workers: Found and opened ten furnished monthly listings across four areas, noting price, size, fees and what each page leaves out
Checked Mexico’s official entry rules for Canadian passport holders and the digital visitor permit, plus official altitude and water guidance
Collected published coworking day and monthly prices from three operators, plus the official Metro and Metrobús fares
Independently re-checked the housing table against the original listing pages

Mexican Embassy in Canada: visas and services
